most companies are still talking about ai agents. ours closed 5,908 tasks in the last 20 days. here's what's actually running inside and soon to be outside @Payward..

inside:
- sep 10 we opened team agents to everyone. 82 requests approved in the first two days

- names like kyc chad, prop clanker, mithrandata and shaggy
- nearly half of those 5,908 tasks started on their own, on schedules and triggers our teams set up. you shouldn't have to tell an agent to get started, you hire them
- busiest ones: our consumer growth agent with 2,118 tasks in 30 days, our regulatory reporting agent with 1,114
- every team agent can write its own upgrades. it writes the code and opens the merge request, a human decides whether it goes in. the agent makes itself better, we still decide what ships
- team agents alone: 6.9B tokens, 160K model calls so far
- agents are starting to use computers: sign into a tool in a cloud browser, replay a recorded workflow, finish the job. in testing now
- 1,276 of us signed up for a personal agent, 1,136 have logged in, 242+ have put one on a schedule
- a dev platform ai team of 3 shipped coding agents, general agents, an llm gateway and company search in under four months
- coding agents: 16,000+ sandboxes since may, 2,900+ merged MRs
- general agents: 85,000+ conversations

outside:
- you can trade just by chatting with kraken's ai in the US app on @krakenfx. those trades grew 17x from early august to mid september as we opened it up. still early, people are using it
- one september week: 22,000 conversations, 2.2B tokens, a typical reply in about 1.4 seconds, about 7 cents a conversation. nobody wants their trading app to stop and think.....
- last december a personalized market brief cost 40 cents a user to generate. two weeks later it was under 3 cents
- the ai side panel is rolling out on @krakenpro. describe a strategy in plain english and backtest it against 180 days. 1,269 backtests in the first month. try the idea before you put money behind it
- trade by chat in telegram, whatsapp, imessage soon..
- or bring your own agent. the open source kraken cli has 170+ commands, 59 agent skills, mcp and paper trading built in. let your agent prove it on paper before it touches real money

next up: agents that remember you, reach out first, and work in the chat apps you already use. breaking news in seconds, load tested at 40,000 live connections. the model should disappear. it should feel like talking to someone who knows you, markets and money..

everything we build for ourselves, we're building for our customers. the agents that run payward are becoming the agents that work for our customers.

agents, not features. this is the slowest it will ever be..

soon we'll have an army, millions of agents we hire, and they hire, and the same self direct behavior we will enable for our customers for free.

we ship, not announce.

items.text:
Yesterday I gave a talk about AI to a room of 50+ oncologists.

As usual, I was the one most excited about it. Then I asked who uses an AI scribe. Only 2 or 3 hands went up.

From start to finish, as I showed what AI can do and what the research says, the pushback came down to two things.

Patient privacy. Whatever a vendor's policy says today, nobody believes the data won't be sold in some form, or that the policy won't change later. After watching this for years, I understand why.

Cost. Many AI scribe companies raise prices once they grow. Doctors notice, and they churn.

The answer in the room was the same every time: AI that runs on-premises, with open-source models.

If the data never leaves the building, the privacy question changes. If the model is open, the pricing question changes.

This is what is stopping many doctors from using AI scribes!

items.text:
Banger paper from CMU on harness learning.

(bookmark it)

Also, pay attention to this important new AI engineering skill of improving agents by editing their harness code instead of their weights.

Seeing a huge shift towards this.

The authors train a proposer model with RL to read a task, the current harness and an execution report, then write a code edit to the harness.

The reward is the score of the revised harness. The solver model never changes.

A trained 4B proposer beats its 35B teacher at single-step revision on Reasoning Gym, including task families it never saw in training. A proposer trained on HotpotQA keeps improving harnesses on MuSiQue and 2WikiMultihopQA.

Paper: https://t.co/wpOoUqPF6r

Google is changing Gemini model access starting Oct 9: • Free → Flash-Lite only • AI Plus → loses Pro models, Flash only • AI Pro & Ultra → retain access to Pro models
日本語訳:

無料・低価格帯から上位モデルが外れるという内容で、引用や反論が多く、関心が高い話題です。非公式アカウントなので、正式発表かどうかは要確認です。
2. ドイツ Aleph Alpha がオープンウェイトモデル「Kolibri」を公開
•投稿者: @Aleph__Alpha（公式）
•時刻: 10月3日 17:54 JST頃（12時間の境界付近。引用・解説はそれ以降も継続）
•反応: いいね約3,000 / リポスト354 / ブックマーク約1,700 / 表示約55万
原文:
Small bird, fast wings, Kolibri is here. 78B parameters. 3.46B active. Up to 1M tokens of context. Built in Europe. Now the weights are yours. Run it on your own hardware, under Apache 2.0.
日本語訳:
小さな鳥、速い羽。Kolibriが来た。 パラメータ数780億、アクティブは34.6億。コンテキストは最大100万トークン。ヨーロッパ製。 重みは公開。Apache 2.0のもと、自分のハードで動かせる。
関連で伸びた解説（@NXT4EU、いいね約1,200）:
ドイツのAleph AlphaがオープンウェイトAIモデル「Kolibri」を公開した。特徴は、渡した文書に答えがないとき「わからない」と言えるよう訓練されている点で、一部の業務では重要。ようやくEUのAIに競争が出てきた。
MoE構成の欧州製オープンモデルとして、技術寄りの反応が厚いです。
3. FortniteのIronmouse関連アートにGemini透かし
•投稿者: @Pirat_Nation ほか
•時刻: 10月3日 22:03 JST頃
•反応: いいね約3,100 / リポスト137 / 表示約12万（関連投稿も同規模）
原文:
Ironmouse faces backlash after players spotted a Google Gemini watermark on the “Meow” Jam Track artwork in her Fortnite Bundle. Ironmouse has been openly anti-generative AI… Ironmouse said she and her team were unaware AI was used and are investigating. The artwork is being replaced with a human-made version.
日本語訳:
IronmouseのFortniteバンドル内「Meow」Jam Trackのアートに、Google Geminiの透かしがあるのをプレイヤーが見つけ、批判が起きている。 Ironmouseは生成AIに公然と反対してきた。本人は、AIが使われたことを自分もチームも知らなかったと述べ、調査中。アートは人間が作った版に差し替えられる。
生成AI反対を公言していた配信者側の素材に透かしが出た、という炎上・話題枠です。
4. Claude Pro と ChatGPT Plus の比較
•投稿者: @Claudeupdates11（非公式）
•時刻: 10月4日 01:25 JST頃
•反応: いいね約1,600 / ブックマーク385 / 表示約13万
原文:
Claude Pro vs ChatGPT Plus Same $20 subscription Both Claude and OpenAI Claude Pro: 3B tokens • 90 TPS ChatGPT Plus: 870M tokens • 25 TPS 50 TPS with Fast Claude Offers a much larger token allowance, along with a higher stated output speed… Which one are you choosing?

Claude Pro対ChatGPT Plus。どちらも月20ドル。 Claude Proは30億トークン、90 TPS。 ChatGPT Plusは8.7億トークン、25 TPS（Fastで50 TPS）。 Claudeの方がトークン枠が大きく、公称の出力速度も高い。どちらを選ぶ？

🖋️A small AI cost-saving idea I like:
Don’t pay a big model to make every tiny decision.

@awscloud’s Strands team just released a 2B open-source model built for things like:

• which tool should run
• where should this request go
• should this action continue

Then use the bigger AI model only for the hard reasoning.

Small model for routine decisions.
Big model for difficult thinking.
That feels like a much healthier AI-agent architecture. 🙂
